interlocks.cause: Guard door open (NOT X32) or E-stop chain lost (NOT X0)
interlocks.effect: De-energise HiPot start/HV enable (Y30) and HV beacon (Y31) immediately

interlocks.cause: HiPot result latched (M310 or M311 ON)
interlocks.effect: De-energise HiPot start/HV enable (Y30) and HV beacon (Y31)

interlocks.cause: Pallet leaves ST30 (falling edge of X33)
interlocks.effect: Reset HiPot PASS (M310) and HiPot FAIL (M311)

steps.entry: Pallet leaves ST30 (X33 falling edge resets M310, M311) or initial state
steps.exit: Pallet in ST30 (X33), guard door closed (X32), E-stop healthy (X0), and no latched result (ANI M310, ANI M311)
steps.name: IDLE

steps.entry: X33 AND X32 AND X0 AND NOT M310 AND NOT M311 (turns on Y30 and Y31)
steps.exit: Tester reports PASS (X30) or FAIL (X31), or interlock lost (X32 or X0 opens)
steps.name: TESTING (HV ENABLED)

steps.entry: PASS signal received (X30 sets M310) or FAIL signal received (X31 sets M311)
steps.exit: Pallet leaves ST30 (X33 falling edge resets M310 and M311)
steps.name: RESULT LATCHED
